item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President supplies an authority and purpose recital followed by a section heading, but this segment directs no actor and itself creates no legal consequence.","evidence":"in order to encourage the recognition of volunteer service and civic participation by all Americans"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and structures an internal executive advisory council, including its membership and terms; the effect is executive organization rather than a change in public legal rights.","evidence":"There is hereby established within the Corporation for National and Community Services (CNCS) the President's Council on Service and Civic Participation"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President is assigned the mandatory internal-management task of designating the Council's Chair and Vice Chair when its leadership is selected; no external legal consequence is prescribed.","evidence":"The President shall designate one member to serve as Chair and one member to serve as Vice Chair."},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Council, federal agencies, CNCS leadership, and designated officers receive administrative, advisory, staffing, support, delegation, and sunset directions; these operate immediately or during Council administration without dictating a later public legal outcome.","evidence":"The Chief Executive Officer of the CNCS shall appoint an Executive Director to head the staff of the Council."}]}
